scope.purpose: Define authority boundaries for Inventor and Vault within mechanical and manufacturing authoring, release, exchange, coordination, and project publication.
scope.boundary: This standard governs authority and handoff semantics. It does not define click-by-click software operation, detailed Vault administration, or client-specific packaging.

requirements.statement: Inventor shall be treated as the authoritative authoring environment for detailed mechanical and manufacturing geometry of governed fabricated components and assemblies within its assigned scope.
Vault shall govern Inventor design data history and lifecycle for manufacturing content within its assigned scope and shall not be treated as a substitute for the project CDE.

Project BIM context, multidisciplinary federation, and project publication authority shall remain with the governed project environments assigned to those domains; Inventor or Vault shall not silently acquire those authorities through exchange or technical capability.

Inventor or Vault outputs consumed by downstream BIM, coordination, fabrication, or project-information processes shall preserve identity, revision or lifecycle context, provenance, and traceability back to the authoritative manufacturing source.
Inventor-to-project exchanges shall use governed workflows that define purpose, representation, acceptance criteria, validation, and downstream reliance before publication or use.
